notes.title: Update V1.22
notes.notes: Hope everyone is doing well. I'm adding a small quality of life update to hopefully help fix some confusion with putting the Broom and Mop back in the closet. Now when you need to place them back there will be a particle blinking there that will disappear once you successfully actually place the tool back.

notes.title: Minor Update V1.21
notes.notes:
Sorry you guys haven't seen any updates for Bite Night in a while. I've been hard at work making my next game Invasion of The Halloween Fiends so that's been taking up most of my time.

Minor Fixes
-Fix sequence breaking bug where players would enter through the backdoor and clean up the dirt without triggering the front door event breaking the game sequence and blocking progression.
-DOORS NOW OPEN INSTANTLY (wow new technology)

notes.title: STEAM ACHIEVEMENT UPDATE!!!!
notes.notes:
Bite Night has just added 19 new achievements to earn. There's ones you'll get by completing the main story and many missable achievements to give you reason to explore the game! 

NOW WITH COLLECTABLE RATS - One of the new achievement adds a nice sprinkling of rats around the map for the players search for and collect - CAN YOU FIND ALL 10???

I hope you all enjoy trying to 100% Bite Night. I'm excited to add these achievements to help highlight some small things the players may have not encountered or noticed on their first playthrough.

notes.title: Hotfix V1.18
notes.notes:
-Fix glitch with opening up the option menu in the main menu.
-Fix issue with the cursor going off the screen when using multiple monitors.
-Add helpful text to the opening subtitle.
-Add Kill Z to respawn the player after accidental falls through the map.
-Made opening cutscene skippable

notes.title: Hotfix V1.15
notes.notes:
Fixed some more bugs

-Fixed spelling and grammar errors.
-Fixed glitch where the dropped broom or mop when repicked up was blocking the player from interacting with anything.
-Fixed confusion with subtitle related to needing to grab the mop before cleaning the washroom.
-Fixed cursor not appearing once the game is beaten.

notes.title: Hotfix V1.14
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where the player was unable to pick up items dropped on the floor of the washroom.

notes.title: Hotfix V1.13
notes.notes:
Fixed Some Bugs


-Fixed task list not opening instantly... (Some people couldn't wait that long)

-Fixed issue in final fight scene being unable to progress due to issue related to high frame rate.


THANK YOU ALL!!!
